subject: Marketplace VAT ID confidence threshold & auto-remediation plan
messages:
From: Emma Li <emma@bazaar.market>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 19 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: VAT ID confidence flagged for seller group — payment hold

Hi Priyom,

We ran the seller batch through our proofing pipeline and one of our larger EU sellers (Merchant ID: BZ-9912) is returning a low-confidence VAT ID match (confidence 42%). Payments are currently being held by our collections flow until we can validate.

Attached is the vat_lookup_summary.pdf showing the cross-check against VIES and a secondary commercial lookup (note the mismatch on the issuing country and the formatting). The seller is pushing for next-week payout — can Redwood consider a temporary remediation path that would let us release funds while we collect stronger evidence?

Questions:
- Do you have an existing confidence threshold where Redwood auto-releases under monitoring?
- If we allow a manual override, what controls should we put in place to avoid tax exposure (reverse-charge misrouting / incorrect self-billing)?

Thanks — Emma
Seller Ops | Bazaar Market
emma@bazaar.market
Attachment: vat_lookup_summary.pdf

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 19 May 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: VAT ID confidence flagged for seller group — payment hold

Hi Emma — thanks for the detailed summary and the PDF.

Short answer: we don't have a blanket auto-release below our conservative threshold (65%), but we do support a staged remediation flow for marketplace sellers:

Proposed short-term mitigation:
- Allow a controlled manual release for this payout if Bazaar submits either (A) an EU VAT registration certificate PDF (official letterhead) or (B) a seller self-attestation form plus a secondary ID (company registration extract).
- If you choose self-attestation, Redwood will apply a 30-day monitoring flag on the merchant's payouts and require an expanded tax checkpoint on the next two payouts.
- We can also run a temporary routing override to force settlement to a non-rc pipeline (i.e., Redwood treats as taxed at source) until the evidence is cleared.

I think the safest path is to request the VAT certificate. If Bazaar needs faster funds, we can accept the attestation + ID and apply the monitoring conditions. I'll loop Finance/legal to confirm policy and record the exception.

Priyom
Senior Partnerships | Redwood Inference
priyom_das@redwood.ai

Subject: Fwd: VAT ID confidence flagged for seller group — payment hold

Folks — forwarding Bazaar Market case. Summary: large EU seller (BZ-9912) failed our VAT confidence check (42%). Seller requesting payout next week. Bazaar Ops asked whether Redwood can provide an auto-remediation or manual-override path that limits tax exposure. Attachment: rc_batch_0423.csv (sample rows from Bazaar's payout batch).

Questions for Finance/Tax:
- Can we accept a seller self-attestation + company registration extract as a temporary release condition?
- If so, what monitoring window and flags do we require in the billing system to reduce reverse-charge risk?
- Any recommended quick checks (country-of-issue vs place-of-supply heuristics) we can run automatically to raise the threshold if suspicious?

Suggested controls (for discussion):
- 14-day remediation window for evidence submission; payments held after 14 days are escalated and not auto-released.
- Require evidence upload to our secure portal + store a copy of the cert in the seller record (audit trail).
- Auto-add a ‘tax-risk’ tag that disables self-billing and forces manual settlement until cleared.

I can coordinate with Bazaar on what specific docs they will provide.

— Priyom
(Attachment: rc_batch_0423.csv)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 19 May 2026 13:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: VAT ID confidence flagged for seller group — payment hold

Agree with proposed mitigation. Operational guidance:

- Acceptable temporary evidence: EU VAT registration certificate OR notarized company extract + seller-attestation form (signed).
- Monitoring: 14-day window from our side to collect supporting docs. If docs not received within 14 days, keep funds in hold and generate an escalation to Tax Ops (TAX-773).
- Billing flags: set tax_risk=true, disable auto self-billing, require manual review checkbox for next two settlements.
- If Bazaar insists on release before the evidence is supplied, we can do a one-off manual override but require an indemnity clause via signed acceptance from Bazaar (we should capture via HubSpot notes and a DocuSign link).

I'll update the playbook and create the HubSpot ticket. Priyom — can you confirm Bazaar will upload the VAT cert to the secure portal? If they need a DocuSign indemnity we'll produce a short form.

Ben Carter
Head of Collections | Redwood Inference
